'''Aleena''' was the native language of [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] from [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] and the colony world [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]]. [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] were also capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].
